station_capacity.semantics: observe physical saturation; never truncate base service or policy holding

event_identity.semantics: audit metadata; excluded from policy observations

count_source_audit.source: SUMO bus-stop waiting-count and transit-vehicle person-count subscriptions at every simulation step

passengers.accounting_semantics: one-second integration of SUMO bus-stop waiting counts and transit-vehicle person counts

policy.selection_rule: all common-budget aliases frozen before evaluation; physical actors deduplicated only by exact tensor SHA256

fewshot_model_checkpoint.scope: model, optimizers, RNG and counters; online replay and simulator runtime state intentionally excluded; not a resume checkpoint

training_metadata.selection_rule: all preregistered online-event milestones; no evaluation outcome selects a checkpoint

generation_config.departure_time_support: clipped to [0, maximum source departure] independently per route

scenario.path_semantics: all runtime paths are relative to this manifest/config; content identity is independent of host mount point
scenario.realization_design: independent stable-uniform departure-time perturbations clipped to each source route's original time support
scenario.scope: passengers only; social traffic and bus timetable are unchanged
